title: Boundary-writing machine
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, choose one of its work tapes, and fix a symbol $b$ in an alphabet $\Gamma$. The resulting $k$-work-tape machine has four states, starts in state $0$, moves the chosen work-tape head left in state $0$, writes $b$ in the scanned cell and moves right in state $1$, then moves right in state $2$; in every other state it makes no work-tape change and remains in state $3$. Its input head stays put throughout, and it emits no output.
